findings.title: Automatic confirmation does not rearm failed or revoked admission scopes
Late verification cannot overwrite concurrent revocation under the current record CAS
Unscoped legacy drafts are isolated from cross-workspace save, rebind, and delete
Handoff grouping preserves distinct target activations and unknown receivers
Provider-reported cost is shown separately from tokens and any verified bill
Native Escape is delivered to the focused PTY without closing the terminal view
The fixed outer wrapper permits the native read path while denying source, authority, and credential writes
Chronological native Q/A is retained beside managed history without promoting failed or mismatched protocol to success

limitations: User personal UX acceptance remains pending. Codex-operated Chromium and native sessions are technical evidence, not human approval; the PR remains a draft source review and this result is not Stable promotion or Gate approval.

Physical backend and effective effort remain unknown where not proved by the Provider. Provider-reported USD is displayed as reported usage, not a verified bill; physical billing and effective effort were not independently established.

The exact reviewer-requested normal-host three-test command was not executed inside this reviewer environment. Its raw current-candidate receipt was independently inspected: it reports exit 0, three tests passed, source_unchanged=true, and the exact candidate SHA/tree. The prior nested namespace limitation remains honestly preserved.

Focused independent reruns passed: 68 Python admission/ownership/history/terminal tests and 56 editor/projection/UX tests; candidate manifest recomputation matched all 194 source entries and the declared candidate SHA. The supplied broad regression, rebuild, Chromium, native, privacy, and syntax records were hash-checked rather than fully repeated here.

The current evidence-manifest and candidate-manifest bind correctly. The historical initial-package-manifest contains an older embedded hash for verification-ids.json than the current verification-ids file; this is treated as a provenance snapshot boundary, while the current evidence-manifest hashes the current file. No source or authority defect was inferred from that historical mismatch.
No source, authority, credential, native transcript, hidden reasoning, model-call, commit, push, merge, or Stable-promotion writes were made by this review.
